server_serial_device.description: The serial device path to connect the server to (e.g., /dev/ttyS0, /dev/ttyUSB0). Corresponds to the -d option.

server_baud_rate.description: The baud rate for the serial device. Corresponds to the -b option.

server_flow_control.description: Enable hardware flow control (RTS/CTS) on the terminal device. Corresponds to the -f option.

server_lock_device.description: Lock the terminal device to prevent other processes from using it. Corresponds to the -K option.

server_socket_path.description: The filesystem path for the socket where the server listens for clients. Corresponds to the -k option.

server_history_lines.description: Number of lines of history stored by the server to inject into client terminals. Corresponds to the -n option.

server_log_file.description: Path to the log file. Sympathy reopens this file on SIGHUP. Corresponds to the -L option.

server_rotate_logs.description: Automatically rotate and compress log files when they grow large. Corresponds to the -R option.

server_log_syslog.description: Log errors to the system syslog. Corresponds to the -S option.

server_pid_file.description: File path to write the server process ID to. Corresponds to the -P option.

terminal_width.description: Initial width of the terminal frame buffer in columns. Corresponds to the -w option.

terminal_height.description: Initial height of the terminal frame buffer in rows. Corresponds to the -w option.

terminal_unicode.description: Attempt to render Unicode characters using ISO-2202 sequences. Corresponds to the -u option.

display_html_dump.description: Render the current internal frame buffer state to stdout as HTML. Corresponds to the -H option.
